claims.text: HFpEF + obesity + T2DM: GLP-1 analogs or GIP-based agents are beneficial if dual therapy = required.
claims.quote: In patients with HFpEF, obesity, and underlying type 2 diabetes, glucagon-like peptide (GLP-1) analogs or glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide (GIP) receptor antagonists are beneficial if dual therapy is required.
